commercial_relevance: Potentially supports KOV's existing candidate-facing information architecture; no conversion, demand, or serviceability forecast is asserted.
unique_content_purpose: A navigational index that organizes KOV's existing candidate-facing career resources and only later adds individually researched guides. It should not duplicate the articles themselves or imply all listed occupations/markets are KOV services.
duplication_and_cannibalisation_assessme: Current materials are already spread across 11 resource pages, 30 FAQs, a glossary, service pages, and role pages. The hub is differentiated only as a curated index; it must link to existing URLs first and not create near-duplicate copy.

evidence_and_date: Competitor/reference pages were opened directly on 2026-11-04; this is a page review, not a Google/Bing SERP ranking study.
No query volume, difficulty, traffic, or conversion data was available.
